g.text: Three survey waves. Each section uses the question and statistic from its own survey.
When could AI solve a long-standing open math problem on its own?
Millennium problems are examples in this broader question.
The comparable 50% date moved from about 2050 to 2053.
ESPAI averages fitted probability distributions. The 2024 item used 130 fitted responses.
The 2023 item count was not recovered. Missing cells are not zero. The year 2822 is shown in full.
LEAP 2025 | Seven groups in one survey wave
Chance that AI solves or substantially helps solve a Millennium Prize Problem
Survey: 18 Aug to 15 Sep 2025. Dots show median respondent probabilities.
All four shaded subgroup rows are part of the all-expert sample.
The public item has 1,022 answers for 2027 and 2030, and 1,021 for 2040.
The questions, respondent groups, and methods differ between ESPAI and LEAP.
These results do not show a steady increase in human optimism.
Sources: AI Impacts ESPAI 2023/2024; FRI LEAP wave 2. Saved source data: 30 Sep 2026.
